known_prior_result: V11.0 transformation-only failed acceptance: 5% mean precision vs 12.5% V10.2, but lower drawdown.
objective: Combine V10.2's validated market signal with transformation-first evidence without allowing weak catalyst features to replace the control.
architecture: V10.2 calibrated p100 is the anchor signal.
Transformation features are used in a regularized temporal meta-model trained only on prior folds.
Final hybrid score retains 70% V10.2 anchor and 30% meta-model evidence before downside penalty.
Candidate pool is the union of high V10.2 candidates and unusually strong transformation candidates.
A separate Early Discovery Radar captures strong early catalysts with low already-priced-in penalty even when they are not in the main Top-10.
The main list is judged against V10.2 on precision, lift, drawdown and recent-fold performance.
No V11.1 weight or threshold is changed after observing V11.1 results.
